android.desc:
PogiFit – Your All-in-One Fitness & Nutrition Companion

PogiFit combines smart nutrition tracking with powerful workout management to help you stay consistent, progress steadily, and actually understand what you’re doing. Whether you’re a complete beginner or an advanced athlete, PogiFit adapts to you.

PogiFit Food

- Get suggested macronutrient distributions based on your body composition and selected goals.

- Prefer to go your own way? Customize every detail of your distribution or keep it as simple as just tracking calories and protein.

- Adjust macros and calories by day of the week to match your lifestyle.

Track your intake with a dynamic food diary that includes:

- User-created foods

- A constantly growing public food library

- Complete recipes you can log and re-use

- Set up your daily supplements and receive reminders so you never miss a dose.

Access comprehensive guides:

- Clear technical manuals for learning how to use PogiFit step by step

- Educational resources that explain nutrition in an easy but thorough way

PogiFit Workout

- Follow your training routine and save a full history of your performance.

- Use a focused workout screen: log only the essentials (weight and reps) or dive into detailed tracking without losing training flow.

- Create or import routines with full flexibility. PogiFit adapts to your goals, from home fitness to bodybuilding, powerlifting, calisthenics, Olympic lifting, CrossFit, or strongman.

- Explore our ever-growing exercise library, curated and updated by the PogiFit team. Each exercise comes with explanations and allows you to see your performance history by movement, not just by session.

- Quick Sessions: create spontaneous workouts with minimal setup.

- Log your NEAT (non-exercise activity) to keep a bigger picture of your daily activity.

- Learn through detailed training guides: just like with Food, you’ll find both user manuals and educational content that help you understand training principles without feeling lost.

PogiFit Shop

Take your fitness journey further with digital packs:

- Recipe collections

- Training programs

- Extended nutrition and workout guides

Unlock even more with subscriptions:

- PogiFit Plus: annual plan that removes ads and removes your storage limit for foods and routines

- PogiFit Premium: annual plan that unlocks everything, with no limits

Why PogiFit?
Because fitness apps shouldn’t just track numbe

show_hn.title: Show HN: PogiFit – Nutrition and Workout Tracker

quotes.text:
Hi HN,

I just launched PogiFit, an app that tracks both nutrition and workouts. The idea is to keep everything in one place: macros, food database, workout routines, exercise history.

It has two parts:

Food: macro diary (auto or manual), option to just track calories + protein, supplement reminders, nutrition guides, different macros per day, and a food database of 100k+ items across all supported languages.

Workout: routine library (home, gym, powerlifting, bodybuilding, etc.), 240+ exercises, routine builder, simple workout tracker, progress history, and 1RM calculators.

I built it with Laravel, PicoCSS, jQuery, MySQL, and packaged it as a mobile app with Cordova. The biggest challenge has been by far keeping 21 languages up to date with every new feature and content, and working around Cordova’s limitations compared to native apps.

Available here:

Play Store - https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.pogifit.mobilepro
Desktop web - https://pogi.fit
